name: BD139
description: Medium-power NPN in TO-126, complementary to the BD140 PNP. Common in class-AB audio output stages, linear regulators, and 1.5A loads. Lead order is E-C-B with the printed face toward you.

TO-126.notes: TO-126, printed face toward you, leads down: E-C-B. The metal tab is the collector.

typical_application: Push-pull audio output stage paired with a BD140, series-pass element in linear supplies, driving relays and small motors. Needs a heatsink near full dissipation.
gotchas: lead order is E-C-B, not the BJT 'EBC' you might expect; the tab is the collector
Pd of 12.5W is the heatsinked figure; without a heatsink it is far lower (~1.25W in free air)
for matched complementary pairs, buy BD139/BD140 from the same gain group
